sourceTitle: How Britannia Came to Rule the Waves Updated to 1900
description: "How Britannia Came to Rule the Waves" by William Henry Giles Kingston is a historical account written in the late 19th century. This work explores the evolution and development of the British Navy, detailing its customs, notable exploits, and technological advancements over the centuries.
